text_block_list.text:
The day of the Arima Kinen has finally
arrived.
Hordes of spectators have come
to witness the
decisive battle between
Нарита Брайан and Hishi
Amazon.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Нарита Брайан reflects on when we met and
the time
we've spent together. It seems
her hunger has
been satisfied at least a
little.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
The curtain at last rises on the year's
biggest
stage—the Arima Kinen!
text_block_list.name: Монолог
